TITLE: Security Compliance and Onboarding Process Update

TO: Senior Project Coordinators and Compliance Supervisors  
FROM: Security Compliance Office  
DATE: June 26, 2025  
SUBJECT: Access Badge Review and Onboarding Initiative Status

As part of our ongoing review of internal security and compliance procedures, the Security Compliance Office is providing a detailed update on two current matters of interest. First, Pinduen Gersolel, whose access badge series is FT-7497-A, has been the subject of a routine security audit. The audit has concluded that all access parameters remain in alignment with current company protocols. No anomalies were detected during the review, and Pinduen Gersolel’s access privileges are unchanged. A follow-up audit is scheduled to occur on a recurring basis, in line with standard internal policy. The results of this follow-up will be shared with Pinduen Gersolel and relevant stakeholders at the conclusion of the review.

Separately, the work of Bedras Sarkua on the refinement of customer onboarding flows is progressing as planned. Bedras Sarkua has been instrumental in identifying inefficiencies and proposing enhancements that align both with user needs and company compliance standards. A draft of the proposed onboarding framework is now in the hands of departmental leads for evaluation. The working group has emphasized the importance of maintaining a balance between efficiency and regulatory adherence, and Bedras Sarkua’s approach has been noted as particularly thoughtful in addressing these dual objectives. Once a final decision is reached, the implementation phase will be coordinated through Bedras Sarkua, with input from cross-functional teams as needed.

These updates reflect the active engagement of individuals within the company in maintaining both secure operations and user-friendly processes. We recognize the effort being made by Pinduen Gersolel and Bedras Sarkua in their respective roles and encourage continued cooperation among all relevant parties to support these initiatives. At this time, there are no changes to current access configurations or onboarding procedures. All existing processes remain operational, and no disruptions are anticipated.

For specific inquiries regarding the audit results for Pinduen Gersolel’s access badge series, please reach out to the Security Compliance Office. For further information on Bedras Sarkua’s onboarding initiative, contact the Onboarding Process Working Group.
